description: Reunion Island: Building Footprints in Areas Impacted by Cyclone Belal is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Google Research. A dataset of building footprints of the Reunion Island, in the area of the January 2023 Belal Cyclone. Building footprints are useful for a range of important applications, from population estimation, urban planning and humanitarian response, to environmental and climate science. Coverage: Réunion. The portal files it under the publisher Google Research. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2024-06-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
